Asset type: vertical whole-level composition for the existing Snabbit hex-grid puzzle game, original sprite art style.

Composition: tall portrait whole map, right-hand refund pocket attached to a sculpted hollow crescent, left side spacious and visibly lower-cost, wider quiet approach below. No text, no arrows, no labels, no colored coding on rocks, no full-width horizontal wall strips, no repetitive zigzag, no collectible rail. This is a suggested map composition with existing game sprites, not a new art style.
